extracted.intended_audience: patent classifiers, patent examiners, IP attorneys and applicants who classify mechanical/vehicle-related patent documents
extracted.subtask_description: A taxonomy/index of patent classification headings and subheadings for mechanical goods, jewellery, transport and hoisting means (lists classes, subclasses and example items to be placed under each). Useful for assigning or searching IPC/USPC-style classifications for patent documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 10-07: Measuring, checking and signalling instruments (watch/clock parts)
rubrics_metrics.description: Casings, dials, hands and all other parts and accessories of measuring, checking and signalling instruments (e.g., for barrels (watch)); watch and clock movements and parts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes: cases for movements (clocks and watches), cases for watches, chain links for watch bracelets, chains (watch-), clasps for watch straps and bracelets, clock striking mechanisms, crowns of watches (winding), dials (hands of instruments), escapements, hairsprings, hands of instrument dials, hinge pins for watch cases, jewel settings, jewels for watch movements, movements for clocks and watches (chassis for movements), pendulums, pivots, pocket-watch bows, pointers (indicating), rims for watches (in which glass is set), springs (watch-), straps (wrist watch-), striking mechanisms (clock-), watch bracelets, winders for watches, winding crowns of watches, wrist watch straps, and related watch/clock parts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 11-01: Articles of adornment / Jewelry
rubrics_metrics.description: Items of personal adornment and jewelry.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes: bracelet links, bracelets, cut diamonds (brilliants), brooches, chains (jewellery), charms, clips (jewellery), diadems, diamonds, ear pendants, earrings, hair fasteners (jewellery), finger-rings, gems, lockets, medallions, necklaces, pearls, pendants, pins, precious stones, religious objects (jewellery), signet rings, solitaire diamonds, wedding rings, and associated jewellery components and findings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 11-02: Trinkets, table, mantel and wall ornaments; flower vases and pots (artware)
rubrics_metrics.description: Decorative household ornaments and artware for display, tables, mantels and walls; flower containers and stands.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes: aquariums for flowers, bas-reliefs, decorative baskets (for holding flowerpots), bowls (flower-), centerpieces (table-), ceramics, painted china (ornamental), Christmas crib figures, epergnes, figurines, flower holders, stands for flower arrangements, mantelpiece ornaments, mobiles (decoration), mosaics, ornamental baskets, purely ornamental glassware, purely ornamental plates and dishes, flowerpot covers, flowerpots, plant pots, and related decorative items.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 11-03: Medals and badges
rubrics_metrics.description: Medals, identification badges and campaign badges.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes identification badges, campaign badges, medals and related insignia used for identification or commemoration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 11-04: Artificial flowers, fruit and plants
rubrics_metrics.description: Imitation vegetation and decorative artificial floral items.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes branches of artificial shrubs, artificial Christmas trees, flower decorations, artificial flowers, foliage (artificial), artificial fruits, funeral wreaths, garlands of artificial flowers or leaves, imitation vegetation, wreaths (artificial), leaves of artificial plants, artificial plants and trees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 11-05: Flags and festive decorations
rubrics_metrics.description: Flags, banners and festival/ceremonial decorative items.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes banners, burgees, candle holders for Christmas trees, Christmas crib items, stockings, tree decorations, coats of arms, escutcheons, festive decorations, flagpoles, flags, garlands, rosettes, streamers, holders for Christmas-tree candles and related festive ornamentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 11-99 (Misc): Miscellaneous insignia and decorative items
rubrics_metrics.description: Various miscellaneous decorative and identification articles not elsewhere specified in Class 11.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes insignia, identification insignia for electoral campaigns, floral decorations, artificial vegetation items, wreaths, mortuary wreaths, creche figures, stage sets, decorative fountains for interiors, and other assorted decorative goods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 12: Means of transport or hoisting (overview)
rubrics_metrics.description: Broad class covering vehicles and means of transport, conveyance systems and hoisting/handling apparatus.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This class is organized into many numbered subcategories (01–16) covering vehicles drawn by animals; handcarts and wheelbarrows; railway locomotives and rolling stock; telpher carriers/chair lifts/ski lifts; elevators, hoists and conveyors; ships and boats; aircraft and space vehicles; motor cars, buses and lorries; tractors; trailers and caravans; cycles and motorcycles; perambulators/invalid chairs/stretcher; special-purpose vehicles; other vehicles (hovercraft, sleighs, etc.); tires; and other parts, equipment and accessories for vehicles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 12-01: Vehicles drawn by animals
rubrics_metrics.description: Vehicles designed to be drawn by animals and their components.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes carriage shafts, timons, tipcarts, and other animal-drawn vehicles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 12-02: Handcarts, wheelbarrows and similar (manual handling carts)
rubrics_metrics.description: Hand-operated carts and handling platforms without hoisting devices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes hand barrows, dumping barrows, garden carts, golf carts, hand barrows, truck platforms, pushcarts for vendors, shopping carts, trolley platforms, platforms for loading, and handling carts for goods (without hoisting devices). Also boat launching cradles and dinner wagons (not furniture).

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 12-03: Locomotives and rolling stock for railways and other rail vehicles
rubrics_metrics.description: Railway locomotives, carriages, wagons and associated components and fittings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes bearings for railway carriages, bodies for railway coaches, bogies, buffers, funicular railway carriages, communicating platforms for carriages, spark deflectors for locomotives, grease boxes, locomotives, luggage racks, mine trucks, monorails, refrigerator cars, tenders, running boards, wheels and metal tyres for railway carriage wheels, steam regulators for locomotives, and other rolling stock parts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 12-04: Telpher carriers, chair lifts and ski lifts
rubrics_metrics.description: Cableways, telepher cables, chair lifts, ski lifts and related components.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes cable cars, cableways (telpher), chair lifts (telesieges), cabins for telepherics, teleskis, remonte-pentes, telepherique cabins and other ski lift installations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 12-05: Elevators and hoists for loading or conveying
rubrics_metrics.description: Elevators, hoists, conveyors, cranes and related lifting and conveying machinery.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes conveyor belts, bucket chains, buckets, capstans, endless carriers, chains for bucket elevators, conveyor belts, cranes (gantry, electro-magnetic, floating), derricks, fork-lift trucks (including hand-operated), gantry cranes, goods hoists, escalators, jacks, pulleys, winches, moving walkways, loading cranes, and other hoisting/handling apparatus.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 12-06: Ships and boats (marine vessels)
rubrics_metrics.description: All types of waterborne vessels and components thereof.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes bathyscaphs, boat hulls, dinghies, life boats, sailing boats, launches, ferries, drydocks, pontoons, propellers, keels, hulls, hydroplanes, ice-breakers, rafts (inflatable), rigging, masts, oars, paddles, launches and small boats, submersibles and ships' superstructures, tankers, trawlers, tugboats, pontoons, life-rafts and related marine equipment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 12-07: Aircraft, space vehicles and yachts
rubrics_metrics.description: Aerial and space vehicles and related fittings; includes yachts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes aircraft, balloons (aerostatic), dirigibles, gliders, gyroplanes, helicopters, hydroplanes (seaplanes), aircraft propellers, space vehicles, stabilizers (aeronautics), yachts and other watercraft classified here.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 12-08: Motor cars, buses and lorries
rubrics_metrics.description: Road motor vehicles including cars, buses, lorries and bodywork parts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes ambulances, motor car bodies, buses, racing cars, coaches, electric cars, front sections/bodywork parts, hoods/bonnets, refrigerator motor trucks, garbage/refuse lorries, tanker trucks, trolleybuses and related road vehicle components and load platforms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 12-09: Tractors
rubrics_metrics.description: Tractors and agricultural traction vehicles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes agricultural tractors and related traction vehicles and components.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 12-10: Trailers, including camping or house trailers
rubrics_metrics.description: Trailers and caravans for road vehicles, including camping caravans.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes caravans, itinerant caravans for camping, road vehicle trailers and similar towable habitations or cargo trailers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 12-11: Cycles and motorcycles (and parts/accessories)
rubrics_metrics.description: Bicycles, motor-assisted bicycles, motorcycles, tricycles, mopeds and their parts and accessories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes chain adjusters, carriers for luggage, brake levers, forks, frames, gear-case and gear-change items (chain-guides), grips, handlebars, holders for pennants, fuel tanks, mudguards, pedals, saddles and saddle covers, chains, sprocket wheels, wheels (chain-type), monocycles, mopeds, motor-assisted cycles, scooters, tricycles, and numerous specific parts for cycles and motorcycles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 12-12: Perambulators, invalid chairs, stretchers
rubrics_metrics.description: Baby carriages, push-chairs, perambulators, invalid chairs and wheeled stretchers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes baby carriages, push-chair frames, perambulators, invalid carriages/chairs, wheeled stretchers, chassis for push-chairs, mudguards for perambulators and related components.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 12-13: Special-purpose vehicles
rubrics_metrics.description: Vehicles built or adapted for special purposes (military, emergency, municipal, mobile services).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes armored tanks, breakdown/wrecking vehicles, street-cleaning and sprinkling trucks, fire engines, mobile kitchens, manure trucks, mobile viewing platforms, snow-plough vehicles, and other vehicles for specialized tasks or industries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 12-14: Other vehicles
rubrics_metrics.description: Other types of vehicles not elsewhere classified: hovercraft, amphibious vehicles, sleds, toboggans, sports sleighs, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes air-cushion vehicles (hovercraft), amphibian vehicles, boats (ice boats), bobsleds, toboggans, sleighs (including sport sleighs), quadricycles, and a variety of nonstandard or recreational vehicles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 12-15: Tires for vehicles
rubrics_metrics.description: Vehicle tires, inner tubes, snow chains, studs and tire accessories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes snow chains for vehicles, inner tubes for pneumatic tires, pneumatic tires, tire spikes/studs, treads, valves, tyre balancers and related tire components.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 12-16: Other parts, equipment and accessories for vehicles (not elsewhere specified)
rubrics_metrics.description: Miscellaneous vehicle parts, fittings and accessories covering a wide range of components.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes shock absorbers, accelerator pedals, air-intake and radiator grilles, anti-dazzle/anti-glare devices, windscreen wiper arms/blades, wheel balancing weights, towing hooks/ropes/bars, decorative beading, brake blocks/shoes, bumpers and bumper guards, radiator caps and covers, luggage carriers (except cycles/motorcycles), caterpillar tracks, couplings, dashboards, defrosters, exhaust pipes, fittings for rearview mirrors, hub caps, articulated mirror joints, steering wheels, suspension parts and springs, starters (hand-crank), sun visors, tyre balancers, and many other accessory items for road and other vehicles.
